name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: The stack behind Accelerator, GoHighLevel and HubSpot connected to the rest of a firm's tools, is the stack I build and support every day. At Solenzo I've architected 20+ GoHighLevel workflows across client accounts, covering pipelines, calendars, forms, appointment booking and reminders, no-show recovery, onboarding, and email and SMS review requests, and I connect GoHighLevel and HubSpot to everything else through Zapier, Make, and n8n. When no-code stops, I write Python or JavaScript in custom code steps to parse and map the data.

The other half of this role is the person on the other end. My clients are business owners who don't want to learn how a webhook works; they want their calendar to book and their follow-ups to send. I've spent 15+ years walking non-technical people through setup and fixes, including 25+ onboardings a month at Wix and complex configuration work for Birdeye partners. I also know the professional-services world: at Accelo I sold and implemented practice-management software for professional-services firms. I also build AI into client systems, and I grade its output against rubrics before trusting it.
I'd welcome a conversation about Accelerator and how I can help your members. I'm available at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
